facts.claim: Spreuerbrücke is a wooden bridge downstream from Chapel Bridge.
facts.sourceLocation: Opening description: another famous wooden bridge ... a little further down the river.

facts.claim: Caspar Meglinger painted its Dance of Death cycle between 1625 and 1635; a chapel is incorporated into the bridge.
facts.sourceLocation: Danse Macabre: Painted by Caspar Meglinger between 1625 and 1635; chapel incorporated into it.
